questions.label: Are you working with a care manager?
questions.description: HPSM must confirm its current care-management and referral requirements.

questions.label: Do you own and live in the home?
questions.description: RTP must verify ownership, residence and its current service area.

questions.label: Do you own other real estate?
questions.description: RTP must confirm whether and how this affects the currently accepted application.

questions.label: Do you intend to remain in this home for at least two years?
questions.description: This prepares a discussion with RTP; the app has not verified the current annual eligibility rules.

questions.label: Are household income documents ready?
questions.description: Follow RTP instructions for adults in the household. Do not upload bank statements or tax records to this app.

questions.label: Is proof of ownership ready?
questions.description: Submit supporting documents through RTP’s official intake process.

questions.label: Is proof of residence ready?
questions.description: Follow official instructions and obscure unnecessary account or Social Security numbers.

questions.label: What repairs would you like RTP to consider?
questions.description: Describe observed issues and requested help. Avoid account numbers, diagnoses or unsupported structural claims.
